# C# and .NET library guidance

- CS-034: A library's author chooses a dependency policy deliberately, removes out-of-support target frameworks from the package, doesn't reference a package when the framework provides the API, and avoids using branching to drop support for in-support frameworks.
- CS-036: A library that targets .NET Standard should target .NET Standard 2.0 unless it needs to support an earlier version, shouldn't target .NET Standard 1.x, and, if it doesn't need to support .NET Framework, should skip .NET Standard 2.1 and go straight to .NET.
